'''Bulger''' was a diminutive [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the [[Restored Empire]] faction. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] he served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]].
